parameters.content:
## WF01: Payout Reconciler

**Project 3, Xero Payment Processor Reconciliation**

One canvas, two ingestion shapes (Stripe webhook + Shopify cron poll), one shared decomposition and Xero-posting downstream. Decomposes each payout into balanced journal lines and posts to Xero as a Manual Journal.

**Compliance posture**: signature verification (structural in test, HMAC-deferred), idempotency on (processor, payout_id), database-level append-only audit, strict balance validation, retry on every external call.

Read this canvas left to right: section headers (purple) explain each band.

Build status: Stripe path tested, Shopify path tested, all 6 test paths run.

## 1. Dual Ingestion (webhook + cron)

**Top branch (Stripe webhook)**: Stripe pushes `payout.paid` or `payout.updated` to the webhook. Signature verification (structural, see ASSUMPTIONS.md for HMAC defer rationale), filter to genuine paid-payout events, tag run context.

**Bottom branch (Shopify cron)**: Shopify Payments has no payout webhook, so this branch polls `GET /shopify_payments/payouts.json?status=paid` daily with a 3-day lookback. Split Out iterates the array, each payout tagged with run context.

## 2. Merge & Idempotency

Both processors converge here. Single LEFT JOIN query against `payment_recon.payouts` (unique on `processor, payout_id`) determines:

- NEW: continue to processor branch
- POSTED: return original JournalID with idempotent: true
- PENDING: return 409 Conflict

FAILED rows allow reprocess so a Xero retry can proceed after credential fixes.

## 3. Dual Branch (fetch + decompose)

**Top branch (Stripe)**: fetch payout detail, paginate balance transactions (starting_after), fetch live account_map, decompose. Maps charge/payment, refund/payment_refund, stripe_fee, adjustment/transfer, payout. Integer minor units throughout.

**Bottom branch (Shopify)**: same shape. Decomposer constructs `adjustment_<reason>` lookup keys for Shopify's adjustment subtypes. Defensive amount parsing handles string-or-numeric major units. Manually unwraps the `{transactions: [...]}` envelope (Stripe's `{data: [...]}` is auto-unwrapped by n8n; Shopify's is not).

Throws on unknown types; first real run surfaces gaps loudly.

## 4. Shared Validation & Xero Posting

Both branches merge into this shared chain. PENDING audit row, balance validation, build Xero ManualJournal, POST to Xero, update POSTED with JournalID.

**Strict-fail validation**: debits must equal credits to the cent. No rounding plug in v1. Any imbalance is signal (missing type, wrong map, sign bug), not noise.

**Why account 855 (Clearing) for payout, not 090 (Bank)**: Xero refuses Manual Journals against BANK-type accounts. The clearing account holds the net payout; bank reconciliation handles the clearing→bank movement when the deposit lands. This is the standard accountant-approved pattern.

## 5. Error Paths & Terminal

Four failure envelopes (Decomposition, Validation, Xero 4xx, Xero 5xx) converge through Update Payouts FAILED → Write FAILED event → Persist FAILED envelope → terminal IF.

**Dual response by source_trigger**: webhook path emits HTTP response (Respond to Webhook); cron path emits no response (NoOp loop continue). The IF on `source_trigger` is the gate that distinguishes them.

**Network failures route to 5xx**: Branch Xero Error 4xx vs 5xx defaults missing httpCode to 0, fails both bounds, lands in 502 envelope. Connection drops, timeouts, retry-exhausted failures are never silently treated as success.

nodes.name: Stripe Webhook Trigger1
nodes.notes: Stripe webhook endpoint. responseMode=responseNode lets the terminal Respond node carry the dynamic envelope. rawBody=true exposes the unparsed body for HMAC verification.

nodes.name: Filter to Paid Payout1
nodes.notes: Proceed only on a payout that is now paid. payout.created (status=pending) and unrelated payout.updated events fall through the false branch to Set 200 IGNORED.

assignments.name: workflow_run_id
assignments.value: ={{ "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx".replace(/[xy]/g, c => { const r = Math.random()*16|0, v = c==="x"?r:(r&0x3|0x8); return v.toString(16); }) }}

nodes.name: Set Stripe Run Context1
nodes.notes: Establishes run context. workflow_run_id is a fresh UUID v4; payout_date converts Stripe unix arrival_date to YYYY-MM-DD.

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger1
nodes.notes: Daily 06:00 UTC poll of Shopify payouts. Can also be triggered manually for testing.

nodes.name: Fetch Shopify Payouts List1
nodes.notes: Lists payouts with status=paid in the last 3 days. 3-day lookback covers weekend gaps; idempotency dedupes anything already processed.

nodes.name: Split Out Payouts1
nodes.notes: Splits response.payouts[] into one item per payout. Empty list terminates cleanly.

assignments.name: workflow_run_id
assignments.value: ={{ "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx".replace(/[xy]/g, c => { const r = Math.random()*16|0, v = c==="x"?r:(r&0x3|0x8); return v.toString(16); }) }}

nodes.name: Set Shopify Run Context1
nodes.notes: Run context per payout. Shopify payout.date already arrives as YYYY-MM-DD so no conversion needed.

nodes.name: Merge Ingestion1
nodes.notes: Combines both ingestion paths. From here, both processors share the same downstream.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  p.id,
  p.status,
  p.xero_journal_id,
  (p.id IS NOT NULL) AS row_exists
FROM (SELECT 1) AS dummy
LEFT JOIN payment_recon.payouts p
  ON p.processor = $1 AND p.payout_id = $2

nodes.name: Idempotency Check1
nodes.notes: Looks up existing payouts row by (processor, payout_id). Returns 0 or 1 row; Resolve Idempotency Code materialises the decision.

nodes.name: Resolve Idempotency1
nodes.notes: Pivot point: combines Postgres lookup + run context. Sets idem_decision so the downstream Switch is a simple equals check.

nodes.name: Idempotency Decision1
nodes.notes: Routes by idem_decision. POSTED -> idempotent envelope, PENDING -> conflict envelope, NEW -> continue to Route by Processor.

nodes.name: Route to Processor Branch1
nodes.notes: Routes to processor-specific fetch + decompose branch.

nodes.name: Fetch Stripe Payout1
nodes.notes: GET /v1/payouts/{id} for authoritative payout amount.

nodes.name: Fetch Stripe Balance Transactions1
nodes.notes: GET /v1/balance_transactions?payout={id}&limit=100, paginated via starting_after until has_more=false.

parameters.query: SELECT transaction_type, xero_account_code, debit_or_credit, description_template FROM payment_recon.account_map WHERE processor = 'stripe' AND active = true;

nodes.name: Fetch Stripe Account Map1
nodes.notes: Fetches the live Stripe account map. Per Design Q2: per-branch fetch keeps DB calls at one per payout (only the active branch fires).

nodes.name: Decompose Stripe1
nodes.notes: Stripe decomposer. Handles charge/refund (Charges-era) AND payment/payment_refund (PaymentIntents-era). Throws on unknown type or empty basket.

nodes.name: Fetch Shopify Payout Detail1
nodes.notes: Confirms authoritative payout amount before posting (list summary alone is not trusted).

nodes.name: Fetch Shopify Balance Transactions1
nodes.notes: GET balance/transactions.json?payout_id=... Shopify cursor pagination via Link header rel=next.

parameters.query: SELECT transaction_type, xero_account_code, debit_or_credit, description_template FROM payment_recon.account_map WHERE processor = 'shopify' AND active = true;

nodes.name: Fetch Shopify Account Map1
nodes.notes: Per-branch Shopify account map fetch.

nodes.name: Decompose Shopify1
nodes.notes: Shopify decomposer. Defensively handles string-or-numeric amount in major units. Throws on unknown type / adjustment_reason.

nodes.name: Merge Decomposed1
nodes.notes: Joins both decomposer outputs into a single stream for shared validation + posting.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO payment_recon.payouts (workflow_run_id, processor, payout_id, status, currency_code, gross_amount_minor, net_amount_minor, fee_amount_minor, refund_amount_minor, adjustment_amount_minor, line_count, lines_json) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'PENDING', 'USD', $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (processor, payout_id) DO UPDATE SET status = 'PENDING', failed_check = NULL, gross_amount_minor = EXCLUDED.gross_amount_minor, net_amount_minor = EXCLUDED.net_amount_minor, fee_amount_minor = EXCLUDED.fee_amount_minor, refund_amount_minor = EXCLUDED.refund_amount_minor, adjustment_amount_minor = EXCLUDED.adjustment_amount_minor, line_count = EXCLUDED.line_count, lines_json = EXCLUDED.lines_json, updated_at = now() RETURNING id AS payout_uuid;

nodes.name: Insert PENDING1
nodes.notes: INSERT ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE: handles FAILED -> reprocess. Identity field triggers protect immutable columns.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO payment_recon.posting_events (payout_uuid, workflow_run_id, event_type, event_data) VALUES ($1, $2, 'RECEIVED', $3::jsonb);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $json.payout_uuid }},={{ $('Merge Decomposed1').item.json.workflow_run_id }},={{ JSON.stringify({ processor: $('Merge Decomposed1').item.json.processor, payout_id: $('Merge Decomposed1').item.json.payout_id, source_trigger: $('Merge Decomposed1').item.json.source_trigger, received_at: $('Merge Decomposed1').item.json.received_at }) }}

nodes.name: Write RECEIVED event1
nodes.notes: Append-only posting_event for RECEIVED. event_data captures source_trigger so audit can distinguish webhook vs cron.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO payment_recon.posting_events (payout_uuid, workflow_run_id, event_type, event_data) VALUES ($1, $2, 'DECOMPOSED', $3::jsonb);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Insert PENDING1').item.json.payout_uuid }},={{ $('Merge Decomposed1').item.json.workflow_run_id }},={{ JSON.stringify({ line_count: $('Merge Decomposed1').item.json.line_count, gross: $('Merge Decomposed1').item.json.gross_amount_minor, net: $('Merge Decomposed1').item.json.net_amount_minor, fee: $('Merge Decomposed1').item.json.fee_amount_minor, refund: $('Merge Decomposed1').item.json.refund_amount_minor, adjustment: $('Merge Decomposed1').item.json.adjustment_amount_minor }) }}

nodes.name: Write DECOMPOSED event1
nodes.notes: DECOMPOSED event with totals summary.

nodes.name: Validate Balance1
nodes.notes: Strict debit=credit check. Throws to error output on imbalance; envelope routes to Set 422 Validation.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO payment_recon.posting_events (payout_uuid, workflow_run_id, event_type, event_data) VALUES ($1, $2, 'VALIDATED', $3::jsonb);

nodes.name: Write VALIDATED event1
nodes.notes: VALIDATED event records balanced totals.

nodes.name: Build Xero Manual Journal1
nodes.notes: Positive LineAmount = debit, negative = credit. Integer minor -> signed major USD.

nodes.name: POST Xero Manual Journal1
nodes.notes: POST /api.xro/2.0/ManualJournals. onError=continueErrorOutput so 4xx/5xx/network failures route to the IF Branch downstream rather than aborting.

nodes.name: Branch Xero Error 4xx vs 5xx1
nodes.notes: TRUE = httpCode in [400, 500) -> 4xx envelope. FALSE = 5xx, missing httpCode (timeout/DNS/connection reset), or post-retry exhaustion -> 5xx envelope. Network failures are NOT treated as success.

parameters.query: UPDATE payment_recon.payouts SET status = 'POSTED', xero_journal_id = $1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $2 RETURNING id AS payout_uuid;

nodes.name: Update Payouts POSTED1
nodes.notes: Marks payout POSTED with Xero JournalID. Identity-field trigger blocks the other immutable columns.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO payment_recon.posting_events (payout_uuid, workflow_run_id, event_type, event_data) VALUES ($1, $2, 'POSTED', $3::jsonb);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $json.payout_uuid }},={{ $('Validate Balance1').item.json.workflow_run_id }},={{ JSON.stringify({ xero_journal_id: $('POST Xero Manual Journal1').item.json.ManualJournals[0].ManualJournalID, line_count: $('Validate Balance1').item.json.line_count }) }}

nodes.name: Write POSTED event1
nodes.notes: POSTED event with Xero JournalID for audit + reversal traceability.

assignments.name: result_body_json
assignments.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ result: 'POSTED', payout_id: $('Validate Balance1').item.json.payout_id, xero_journal_id: $('POST Xero Manual Journal1').item.json.ManualJournals[0].ManualJournalID, line_count: $('Validate Balance1').item.json.line_count }) }}

nodes.name: Set "Success 200" envelope1
nodes.notes: Terminal success envelope.

nodes.name: Set "401 UNAUTHORIZED" envelope1
nodes.notes: Stripe-only. Sig Verify error output lands here. Shopify has no inbound signature.

nodes.name: Set "200 IGNORED" envelope1
nodes.notes: Filter to Paid Payout false branch. Stripe sends many non-paid lifecycle events; we 200 them so Stripe doesn't retry.

assignments.name: result_body_json
assignments.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ result: 'POSTED', payout_id: $json.payout_id, xero_journal_id: $json.existing_xero_journal_id, idempotent: true }) }}

nodes.name: Set "200 Idempotent" envelope1
nodes.notes: Existing POSTED row. Returns original JournalID.

nodes.name: Set "409 Conflict" envelope1
nodes.notes: Existing PENDING row. Concurrent run in progress.

assignments.name: result_body_json
assignments.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ result: 'FAILED', payout_id: $('Resolve Idempotency1').item.json.payout_id, failed_check: 'decomposition', message: ($json.error && $json.error.message) || 'Decomposition error' }) }}

nodes.name: Set "422 Decomposition" envelope1
nodes.notes: Receives error output from both Decompose Stripe and Decompose Shopify. Multi-parent input is intentional.

assignments.name: result_body_json
assignments.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ result: 'FAILED', payout_id: $('Merge Decomposed1').item.json.payout_id, failed_check: 'unbalanced', message: ($json.error && $json.error.message) || 'Validation error' }) }}

nodes.name: Set "422 Validation" envelope1
nodes.notes: Validate Balance error output lands here.

assignments.name: result_body_json
assignments.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ result: 'FAILED', payout_id: $('Validate Balance1').item.json.payout_id, failed_check: 'xero_4xx', message: ($json.error && $json.error.message) || 'Xero 4xx', http_code: ($json.error && $json.error.httpCode) || null }) }}

nodes.name: Set "422 Xero 4xx" envelope1
nodes.notes: Branch Xero Error true branch (httpCode in [400, 500)).

assignments.name: result_body_json
assignments.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ result: 'FAILED', payout_id: $('Validate Balance1').item.json.payout_id, failed_check: 'xero_5xx', message: ($json.error && $json.error.message) || 'Xero 5xx or network failure', http_code: ($json.error && $json.error.httpCode) || null }) }}

nodes.name: Set "502 Xero 5xx" envelope1
nodes.notes: Branch Xero Error false branch. Catches 5xx, missing httpCode (timeouts, DNS, connection failures), and post-retry exhaustion. Confirmed: NOT treated as success.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO payment_recon.payouts (workflow_run_id, processor, payout_id, status, failed_check, currency_code) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'FAILED', $4, 'USD') ON CONFLICT (processor, payout_id) DO UPDATE SET status = 'FAILED', failed_check = EXCLUDED.failed_check, updated_at = now() RETURNING id AS payout_uuid;

nodes.name: Update Payouts FAILED1
nodes.notes: Multi-parent: receives from all four FAILED envelopes. ON CONFLICT handles both 'no PENDING row yet' (decomposition fail) and 'PENDING row exists' cases. Identity-field triggers protect immutable columns.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO payment_recon.posting_events (payout_uuid, workflow_run_id, event_type, event_data) VALUES ($1, $2, 'FAILED', $3::jsonb);

nodes.name: Write FAILED event1
nodes.notes: FAILED posting_event with the full result envelope for audit.

nodes.name: Persist FAILED envelope1
nodes.notes: Restores envelope fields after the Postgres FAILED writes. Postgres node output may or may not pass through input fields depending on version + config; this guarantees the terminal IF sees http_code/result_body_json/source_trigger.

nodes.name: IF source_trigger == webhook1
nodes.notes: Single terminal gate. Multi-parent: receives from Success, all early-exits (UNAUTHORIZED, IGNORED, Idempotent, Conflict), and Persist FAILED envelope. TRUE -> Respond, FALSE -> NoOp.

nodes.name: Respond to Webhook1
nodes.notes: Single dynamic responder. http_code and result_body_json come from whichever envelope fired. The Webhook trigger's responseMode=responseNode wires this back to the caller.

nodes.name: NoOp (loop continue)1
nodes.notes: Shopify cron path terminator. SplitOut item terminates here; next payout in the batch advances naturally.

nodes.name: Stripe Sig Verify (structural)1
nodes.notes: HMAC-SHA256 verification of Stripe-Signature. On failure, error output routes to Set 401 UNAUTHORIZED envelope.
